name: ArchiveTeam-Warrior
description: The Archive Team Warrior is a virtual archiving appliance. You can run it to help with the Archive Team archiving efforts. It will download sites and upload them to our archive—and it’s really easy to do! Maintained by: JakeShirley

variables.name: Project
variables.description: 'auto' to use the ArchiveTeam's choice, otherwise the project ID you want to use. You might be able to find project IDs here: http://tracker.archiveteam.org/

variables.name: Display Name
variables.description: Name that will be displayed in ArchiveTeam project leaderboards

variables.name: Concurrent Jobs
variables.description: How many concurrent job tasks can run at a time. Max: 6
